title: Raja Mahal
desc: Three college friends decide to open a resort. However, their lives change when they start experiencing paranormal activities in their resort.

title: Randhawa
desc: A photographer named Robert travels to a remote village to investigate strange recurring dreams he has been having. Soon, he discovers a link between himself and a legendary king.

title: Gaja
desc: A cat and mouse chase ensues between Gaja and a rival faction leader over a few startling events. Gaja tries to protect his friend, Krishna, and his lover, Shwetha, who are being targeted.

title: Khaki
desc: A brave policeman is tasked to deal with Eji, a terrorist, who has taken a young woman, Sudha, hostage. Meanwhile, Eji tells Sudha why he turned evil and seeks revenge.

title: Apoorva Sangama
desc: Brothers Raj and Shankar choose opposing paths after goons murder their father. Raj turns outlaw seeking vengeance, Shankar joins the police force.
